protocol: locate the latest canonical resume package and preserve its verified gains
reconcile source, claim, evidence state, artifact, and production deltas
identify the highest-value recruiter, ATS, technical, or web-design improvement
apply the narrowest improvement across every affected projection
run factual invariance, template, render, responsive, accessibility, and artifact checks
persist exact hashes, blockers, non-claims, and the next candidate state
invariants: never restart from an older resume when a newer canonical package exists
never trade factual precision for stronger-sounding copy
every human projection remains derivable from the canonical fact graph
every artifact change invalidates prior hashes until recomputed
every web change is checked against accessibility and responsive contracts
completion requires usable artifacts and a truthful release receipt

composition.precedence: after stone governing laws and before mission-specific style

verification.status_rule: CANDIDATE until exact-head CI validates three-stone composition and recursive invariants
